slides.headline: A Free Trial, a Wrongful-Death Defense
slides.subheadline: Disney sought arbitration—not automatic immunity from damages.

items.label: 2019 signup
items.body: Disney invoked Piccolo’s Disney+ trial in a 2024 lawsuit.

items.label: Requested relief
items.body: Compel arbitration and stay the court action.

slides.headline: Three Documents. Two Assent Episodes.
slides.subheadline: Disney built its argument across products and transactions.

items.label: 3 linked documents
items.body: Disney relied on linked agreements, not one isolated click.

items.label: 2 alleged assents
items.body: Disney cited a 2019 trial and September 2023 tickets.

slides.headline: Delegation Has a Judicial Boundary
slides.subheadline: Coinbase, May 23, 2024: a unanimous Court addressed 2 agreements.

items.label: Coinbase ruling
items.body: A court decides which conflicting agreement governs.

items.label: Disney distinction
items.body: It did not resolve estate-binding or restaurant injuries.

slides.headline: From Signup to Forum Control
slides.subheadline: Disney proposed these links; enforceability remained contested.

items.label: Build assent
items.body: Signup → linked terms → September 2023 ticket purchase.

items.label: Redirect dispute
items.body: Website claims → delegation → arbitration and stay.

slides.headline: The Clicker Was Not the Estate
slides.subheadline: Guest-consent language did not establish authority to bind it.

items.label: Whose consent?
items.body: Piccolo’s assent did not establish estate-binding authority.

items.label: Which claims?
items.body: Disney used website allergy claims as its proposed bridge.

slides.headline: The Mortgage Ban Is Not Universal
slides.subheadline: The CFPB’s 2015 fact sheet identifies a sector-specific ban.

items.label: Mortgage contracts
items.body: Dodd-Frank prohibits arbitration clauses in these contracts.

items.label: Disney agreements
items.body: That mortgage prohibition does not cover these agreements.

slides.headline: Audit Consent Before Claiming Cover
slides.subheadline: Public backlash preceded Disney’s retreat—not a merits ruling.

items.label: Consent audit
items.body: Check who assented, governing terms, claims, and who decides.

items.label: Unrealized advantage
items.body: Disney withdrew without securing the requested arbitration.
